decisionRules.nativeApproval: Concrete unresolved gaps in both supported bridges or a documented segment unable to use either; measurable benefit; preserved hard gates; lower long-term cost than existing hosts or a bounded utility. Hypothetical parity earns no benefit.
decisionRules.scoring: 0–5 anchored ratings per category; weighted total out of 100 only for candidates eligible under hard gates. Unsupported or unbuilt behavior gets no credit. Preserve raw default and configured results separately.
sensitivity: vary each weight by plus/minus 25 percent then renormalize
decisionRules.review: Separate same-session evidence audit and automated independent calculation; do not claim another human or agent reviewed.

measurementRules.package: one exact locally packed jQStar tarball installed in an isolated consumer for every candidate; original exact published hosts and lock integrity; no source aliases or direct repository dist serving
measurementRules.fixtureFreeze: hash shared server, HTML, driver, instrumentation and startup/config files before first browser baseline; amendments retain rationale and rerun affected candidates
measurementRules.runs: one complete three-browser matrix per declared default/configured integration revision; deterministic repeated-visit/cancellation flows are in the driver; runtime timing is descriptive and never a lone correctness assertion
measurementRules.raw: preserve actual requests, semantic event extras, failed/default runs, applicability, browser/package identities, source digests, disposal facts and raw/gzip/install graph costs
measurementRules.costs: separate host distributions, installed consumer, common jQStar/UI cost and research instrumentation; record markup/config/server/API/source/test/docs support and annual maintenance ranges; unbuilt native byte cost stays unmeasured
measurementRules.baseline: any applicable no-JavaScript baseline failure blocks decision completion; enhanced assertions cannot weaken the baseline
measurementRules.normalGate: same driver supplies a bounded browser regression subset; schema/contract tests bind complete recorded comparison to exact research/runtime identities; changed frozen inputs require a full new measurement
measurementRules.redaction: only fixed route/role/event/category identifiers, booleans and counts; no arbitrary URL/query/headers/cookies/form/file/body/HTML/state/error/DOM values

decision.reason: Keep native browser navigation as the baseline and explicitly installed Turbo/htmx bridges for enhanced needs. The configured fixed workflow passes with public host policy and bounded application hooks. The remaining rapid-history limitation is not shared by both hosts; no documented product segment excludes both. Native candidates have no passing implementation or measured advantage and fail the frozen approval rule. No generic utility is approved.
